Class GameView

java.lang.Object
gui.ingame.GameView
public class GameView extends Object
The primary view controller for the active game board.

This class serves as the bridge between the underlying GameLogic and the visual JavaFX nodes displayed to the player. It manages the rendering of entities (enemies and towers), dynamic UI elements (wave counters, floating text, previews), and handles user interactions such as placing towers and opening menus.
